reviews.title: Great tool for the couch potato
reviews.text: I have not run in nearly 30 years since college.  I have been on a fitness journey all year trying to lose 150lbs.  With around 100 left on my goal I decided to set a goal of running a 5k before I turn 50.  I was worried I could not do it but this app starts you out at a reasonable level for those of us more couch than run.  I have done three workouts and pretty excited as I’m not sore and feel pretty accomplished and motivated to keep going.  I don’t know how they program for those more fit it’s tailored to your survey but for a new runner and out of shape I feel like they understand and have set a reasonable expectation for me.

reviews.title: Best app for beginners
reviews.text:
The Couch to 5K app has been a game changer for me! As a complete beginner, I was intimidated by running, but this app made it feel achievable. The workouts are easy to follow, build your endurance gradually, and fit perfectly into my overall fitness journey.

It’s motivated me to get off the couch, get outside, and actually look forward to running. I love that it encourages progress at your own pace without feeling overwhelming. If you’re new to running or looking for a simple, beginner-friendly way to get started, I highly recommend giving this app a try!
